normal.name: Somē
normal.text: I finally finished Persona 5 Royal! For the amount of trudging through that the game made me do from palaces 5 to 7, I'm kinda underwhelmed by the true ending. It didn't give me the same emotional catharsis as in Persona 4 Golden, where the circle of friends was smaller and more tight knit. The best relationship development arc imo was with Sojiro. Really loved how he turned out to be at the end of the story. #persona5 #p5r #gaming #jrpg #persona4
